label: Inferred
meaning: Per-observable-consequence candidate coverage. F1/F3 fixes retained; F2 now requires unavoidable checked transport, ingest gate, independent provenance and protected durable audit. No implementation/full-spec PASS is implied. Six candidate execution N/As remain unmapped until ordinary adoption; four old adopted A4 scopes unchanged. F4 now gates owned acquisition before any persistent source write and retains only fully admitted closure; fixed control projection is explicitly bounded, not a contract exception. F5 source metadata egress independently instantiates RFC5-14/15/25 before source helper/network; limits row cites its actual capability predicate, not RFC5-12 consent classes. F6 explicitly specifies specialized local renderer-product and URL design inert-view boundaries, not unchanged F5 raw025 admission or a detector/private/unknown exemption. F7 enumerates RFC5-3/5/6/7 authentication/lifecycle and RFC3-2/15/VIS-5 canonical home/write/projection consequences separately; required identity never Unknown admission. B2 paired actual-mode provenance and precise BOM scope included. F8 explicitly amends RFC3-2/15/16/(a)/(b), RFC5-6 and adds RFC3-16(d) for exactly bounded URL runtime instances after real parent adoption; effective-authority/antirollback/next-act parent state is enumerated, not an applicability-only waiver. Ordered design admission uses existing RFC5-15/16/25 with separately scoped live proof through terminal verdict eligibility.
